references.text: Describes cosmic disturbances and celestial phenomena as part of God's judgment.
Speaks of the sun and moon being darkened in connection with the day of the Lord.
Refers to a time of cosmic unrest before the day of the Lord.
Describes a great earthquake and cosmic events, including the sun becoming black and the moon turning like blood.
Mentions a third of the sun, moon, and stars being struck with darkness.
